rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACgoofy
Exhibition name: Papageno ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1982).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) as 'Papageno'.
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Union e.G. in 1989 as 'Papageno'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-red, cream or off-white streaks, stripes, flecks. Mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, upright. Large, matte foliage.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous. a good subject for pegging. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Named for the birdcatcher in Mozart's opera The Magic Flute.

colour: Rose-red, cream or off-white streaks, stripes, flecks.
